camera-player-eye.js: (() => { const c = objects('player-eye').find(o => o.isCamera); if (!c) return false; c.updateMatrixWorld(true); const e = c.matrixWorld.elements; const pitch = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, e[9]))) * 180 / Math.PI; return pitch >= 22 && pitch <= 35; })()
camera-player-eye.note: A camera tagged player-eye exists in the graph and is pitched 25-30 deg downward (accepted 22-35) so the frame contains the ground the player stands on.

character-parts.js: objects('enemy').length > 0 && objects('enemy').every(o => { if (o.userData && o.userData.asset) return true; let n = 0; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isMesh) n++; }); return n >= 5; })
character-parts.note: Each enemy is at least 5 meshes (head, torso, two arms, two legs…) — a single capsule is a placeholder. A modelled asset (userData.asset from src/assets.js) counts as built from parts.

crosshair-hides-in-ads.name: ads
crosshair-hides-in-ads.note: The same ads demo returns crosshairVisible from __studio.hud.get('crosshair') — the crosshair is hidden while aiming down sights.

demo-walk.name: walk
demo-walk.note: The named config.demos entry "walk" (a short deterministic control script) runs to its end state without a console error; pair with player-moved for the probe side.

drawcalls-ceiling.note: state() reports draw calls captured after the world render (not the post-pass quad) under a seed ceiling of 1000 calls / 400k triangles (skills: low hundreds of thousands; fix fps < ~50 first).

facade-recess-seams.js: objects('window').length >= 2 && objects('window').every(w => (w.userData.recess || 0) >= 0.1) && count('seam') >= 4 && (objects('facade').length < 3 || new Set(objects('facade').map(f => f.userData.variant)).size >= 3)
facade-recess-seams.note: Windows recessed >= 0.1 m (userData.recess), >= 4 panel seam lines break the slab, >= 3 facade variants once 3+ facades exist; flat repeated boxes score generic every time.

fire-registers.note: probes() reports shotsFired; the scripted controls hold Mouse1 for 0.3 s, so at least one shot must register through ctx.keys.has('Mouse1').

fog-band-not-bath.js: (!scene.fog || !('density' in scene.fog) || scene.fog.density <= 0.008) && count('mist') > 0 && bbox('mist').max.y <= 1.3 && materials('mist').every(m => m.transparent && m.opacity <= 0.3)
fog-band-not-bath.note: Global FogExp2 density <= 0.008 (winter exterior) and knee mist exists as a separate tagged layer no taller than ~1.2 m with opacity <= 0.3 - a band, not a bath.

grade-band.note: Default frame sits in the mid-tone band (mean luma 0.32-0.45) with at most 2% of pixels above 0.9 luma; washed-out / high-key is a measurable fail, not taste.

grade-black-point.note: A black point was set: the darkest 5% of the default frame falls below 0.06 luma; a missing black point is what reads as low-contrast.

grounded.js: (() => { const g = bbox('ground'); const floor = g ? g.max[1] : 0; const list = objects('enemy').concat(objects('npc')); return list.length > 0 && list.every(o => { const b = bboxOf(o); return b && b.min[1] >= floor - 0.05 && b.min[1] <= floor + 0.12; }); })()
grounded.note: Every object tagged enemy or npc stands on the ground: its world bbox bottom is within 5 cm below / 12 cm above the top of the ground mesh (tag the walkable floor ground).

grounded-high-contrast.note: Eye-height frame at spawn sits in a grounded, contrasty band: mean luma 0.18-0.30, at most 60% of pixels lit, at least 12% near black — measured where the player looks, not on a wide default camera (which the mid-key grade-band satisfied while the eye frames were washed).

hands-present.note: First-person: an object tagged hands (or a group holding the arms) exists with real geometry; a gun floating without hands is the first thing a player sees.

instance-variance.js: (() => { const ms = meshes('block'); if (!ms.length) return false; const inst = ms.filter(m => m.isInstancedMesh); if (inst.length) return inst.every(m => m.count >= 40 && !!m.instanceColor); if (ms.length < 40) return false; const sig = m => m.scale.x.toFixed(2) + ',' + m.scale.y.toFixed(2) + ',' + m.rotation.y.toFixed(2); return new Set(ms.map(sig)).size >= ms.length * 0.8; })()
instance-variance.note: Masonry/props tagged block are >= 40 instances with per-instance colour (instanceColor) or >= 80% unique scale/rotation signatures; tiled repeating masonry and identical props are standing rejections.

lamp-warm-pool.js: objects('lamp').some(o => o.isLight) && objects('lamp').filter(o => o.isLight).every(l => l.color.r > 1.5 * l.color.b && l.intensity >= 3 && l.intensity <= 8 && l.distance >= 20 && l.distance <= 40)
lamp-warm-pool.note: Every light tagged lamp is warm amber (0xff8833-class: red > 1.5x blue), intensity 3-8, distance 20-40 - a cold-blue pool under a sodium lamp is an immediate rejection.

lit-fraction-floor.note: Exterior/arena default frame is not under-lit: >= 20% of pixels read as lit (seed floor; the skills only name under-lit / flat void as a loss). Dark interiors are exempt (near-black target).

masonry-reads-weathered.ask: Do the nearest walls read as weathered stone or plaster with visible surface texture (courses, grime, wear), rather than flat painted colour?
masonry-reads-weathered.note: The material read the taste judge kept naming as [primitive] / [noise-as-texture].

materials-mapped-identity.js: (() => { const ids = (typeof identityTags !== 'undefined' ? identityTags : tags()).filter(t => t !== 'hud'); return ids.length > 0 && ids.every(t => materials(t).length > 0 && materials(t).every(m => m.map || m.userData?.triplanar || m.userData?.asset)); })()
materials-mapped-identity.note: Every material on the facet's identity tags has a map (baked via src/materials.js), a triplanar projection, or belongs to a modelled asset (userData.asset, stamped by src/assets.js — loadAsset bakes a map onto any asset material that has none) — a flat MeshStandardMaterial is an untextured box. Replace tags() with the facet's identity tag list in the js.

materials-no-flat-buildings.note: Buildings carry baked masonry/plaster/wood maps from src/materials.js, never flat colour.

materials-roughness-varies.js: materials().filter(m => m.isMeshStandardMaterial).some(m => m.roughnessMap) && materials().filter(m => m.isMeshStandardMaterial).some(m => m.bumpMap || m.normalMap)
materials-roughness-varies.note: At least one standard material in the scene has a roughness map and one has bump/normal detail — surfaces read as materials, not paint.

mirror-rt.note: A planar-mirror render target of at least 1024x1024 exists; 512 and below is what reads as blocky/stepped, 256 never passes.

muzzle-on-weapon.js: count('muzzle') === 1 && (() => { let p = objects('muzzle')[0].parent, ok = false; while (p) { if (p.userData && p.userData.tag === 'weapon') ok = true; p = p.parent; } return ok; })()
muzzle-on-weapon.note: Exactly one object tagged muzzle (the flash/emitter) and it is parented under the weapon, so it moves with the barrel instead of floating in the frame.

no-blown-pools.note: At most 2% of the eye-height frame is clipped to white — lamp pools and bloom stay below clipping.

no-haze-planes.js: objects().filter(o => o.isMesh && o.material && (o.material.transparent || o.material.blending === 2) && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'PlaneGeometry' && Math.abs(Math.abs(o.rotation.x) - Math.PI / 2) < 0.01).every(o => { const b = bboxOf(o); return !b || b.min[1] <= 0.05; })
no-haze-planes.note: No translucent or additive horizontal plane sits above the floor: a haze plane at 0.3-0.8 m cuts through every crate and reads as 'filled with water'. Ground fog is a vertical-gradient fog term or a floor-hugging texture at y<=0.05.

no-light-cones.js: objects().filter(o => o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'ConeGeometry' && o.material && (o.material.transparent || o.material.blending === 2)).length === 0
no-light-cones.note: No translucent cone meshes stand in for light shafts — they read as pale pyramids ('huts') from every wide camera. Use bloom on the emitter or a soft sprite instead.

no-moire.note: Mean neighbour luma step (edgeDensity, 0-1) stays low: fine repeating stripes on ceilings and skies push it up. Seed guess; calibrate on the first run that carries it.

player-moved.note: After the harness drives WASD via press_keys / a demo script, state().player.x or .z changed; identical before/after means "the controls do not work".

precip-three-layers.js: [['precip-near', 40], ['precip-mid', 150], ['precip-far', 400]].every(([t, min]) => objects(t).reduce((n, o) => n + (o.isInstancedMesh ? o.count : (o.geometry && o.geometry.attributes.position ? o.geometry.attributes.position.count : 1)), 0) >= min)
precip-three-layers.note: Rain/snow has three separately tagged depth emitters with rising counts (near >= 40, mid >= 150, far >= 400; craft numbers 200/600/1500); one system reads as sparse short dashes at any density.

puff-coverage.note: Captured during the breath/smoke effect from the first-person default camera: bright puff pixels cover at most ~10% of the frame, else it is a blob, not breath.

puff-sprites.note: First-person breath/smoke sprites are 0.02-0.08 world units and opacity <= 0.35 (an emitter must be tagged); a world-sized sprite in front of the lens is one enormous white blob.

roof-strips-layered.note: Every tagged roof is built from >= 5 overlapping strips per slope (>= 10 per pitched roof) plus a ridge object; a single roof plane reads as plank-like and a flat top as a grey box.

sight-aligns-in-ads.name: ads
sight-aligns-in-ads.note: A demo named ads enters aim-down-sights and returns { sightNdc: {x, y} } — the tagged sight projected into NDC (sight.getWorldPosition(v); v.project(camera)); within 3% of screen centre.

silhouette-varies.js: (() => { const list = objects('enemy'); if (list.length < 3) return false; const sig = o => { const b = bboxOf(o); return b ? b.size.map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(',') : ''; }; return new Set(list.map(sig)).size >= Math.min(3, Math.ceil(list.length / 3)); })()
silhouette-varies.note: With 3+ enemies, their bounding sizes are not all identical (at least 3 distinct silhouettes, or a third of the count) — identical capsules read as blobs.

sky-no-starfield.note: A tagged gradient sky dome exists and nothing tagged star/starfield does; a sky sprinkled with stars to the zenith lost a whole 20-iteration facet.

terrain-opaque.note: The walkable ground is opaque (transparent false, opacity 1, depthWrite true); a milky semi-transparent floor at the player feet hides from vista cameras and shows within two seconds of walking.

tree-snow-ridges.note: Snow ridges sit only on branches of radius >= 0.04 world units (twigs bare) and trunks are >= 0.12 at the base; white coating on the finest twigs is read as spray, thin trunks as pale sticks.

water-dark-albedo.js: materials('water').length > 0 && materials('water').every(m => { const c = m.color || (m.uniforms && m.uniforms.uBase && m.uniforms.uBase.value); return !!c && c.getHSL({ h: 0, s: 0, l: 0 }, 'srgb').l <= 0.22 && (m.roughness === undefined || m.roughness >= 0.3); })
water-dark-albedo.note: Tagged water carries a dark depth-tinted base (sRGB lightness <= 0.22, e.g. #2b3324) and roughness >= 0.3; a pale mirror-grey plane is an automatic fail.

weapon-silhouette.js: meshes('weapon').some(m => m.userData && m.userData.asset) || (meshes('weapon').length >= 4 && new Set(meshes('weapon').map(m => m.geometry && m.geometry.type)).size >= 2)
weapon-silhouette.note: The weapon is built from at least 4 meshes of at least 2 geometry types (body, barrel, grip, sight…) — one box is a primitive, not a gun. A modelled asset (userData.asset from src/assets.js) counts as built from parts.

no-bare-ground.js: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome|water-plane/i; const all = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)); const pts = all.map(o => o.getWorldPosition(o.position.clone())); const px = player?.x ?? state?.player?.x ?? 0, pz = player?.z ?? state?.player?.z ?? 0; let hit = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const a = i * 2.399963, r = 4 + 21 * ((i * 0.618034) % 1); const x = px + Math.cos(a) * r, z = pz + Math.sin(a) * r; if (pts.some(p => (p.x - x) * (p.x - x) + (p.z - z) * (p.z - z) <= 9)) hit++; } return hit / 60 >= 0.6; })()
no-bare-ground.detail: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome|water-plane/i; const all = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)); const pts = all.map(o => o.getWorldPosition(o.position.clone())); const px = player?.x ?? 0, pz = player?.z ?? 0; let hit = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const a = i * 2.399963, r = 4 + 21 * ((i * 0.618034) % 1); const x = px + Math.cos(a) * r, z = pz + Math.sin(a) * r; if (pts.some(p => (p.x - x) * (p.x - x) + (p.z - z) * (p.z - z) <= 9)) hit++; } return 'sample points within 25 m of the player that have a tagged object within 3 m: ' + hit + '/60 (need 36)'; })()
no-bare-ground.note: Extent: of 60 points sampled in a 25 m disc around the player, at least 60% have some tagged object (not terrain/sky/fog/lights) within 3 m. Bare ground between the buildings is what makes a village read as a stage set.

three-scales.js: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome/i; const sizes = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)).map(o => bboxOf(o)).filter(Boolean).map(b => Math.max(b.size[0], b.size[1], b.size[2])); const large = sizes.filter(s => s > 4).length, medium = sizes.filter(s => s > 1 && s <= 4).length, small = sizes.filter(s => s > 0.05 && s <= 1).length; return large >= 3 && medium >= 10 && small >= 30; })()
three-scales.detail: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome/i; const sizes = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)).map(o => bboxOf(o)).filter(Boolean).map(b => Math.max(b.size[0], b.size[1], b.size[2])); return 'large(>4m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 4).length + '/3, medium(1-4m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 1 && s <= 4).length + '/10, small(<1m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 0.05 && s <= 1).length + '/30'; })()
three-scales.note: Scales: at least 3 large (>4 m), 10 medium (1–4 m) and 30 small (<1 m) tagged objects exist. A frame with only buildings and mud is missing two of the three scales a real place has.

life-tagged.detail: 'moving-kind objects (people, animals, smoke, cloth, fire, water, foliage): ' + tags().filter(t => /villager|npc|person|animal|bird|chicken|goat|dog|horse|smoke|cloth|laundry|flag|banner|fire|flame|water|leaf|foliage|wind/i.test(t)).reduce((n, t) => n + count(t), 0)
life-tagged.note: Life: at least three objects of a kind that moves (people, animals, smoke, laundry, fire, water, foliage) exist and are tagged as such. A floor, not a proof of motion — the liveness critic judges whether they actually move.

world-continues.ask: Beyond the nearest buildings or objects, does the world visibly continue (a path leaving, fields, trees, hills, more buildings) rather than ending in bare ground or an empty horizon?
world-continues.note: Extent, from the player's eye at spawn: the place must read as part of a larger world.

foliage-is-cards.js: (() => { const trees = [...objects('tree'), ...objects('bush')]; if (!trees.length) return false; return trees.every(t => { if (t.userData && t.userData.asset) return true; let cards = 0, solids = 0; t.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (m && (m.alphaTest > 0 || m.transparent)) cards++; else if (/Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(o.geometry?.type ?? '')) solids++; }); return cards >= 6 && solids === 0; }); })()
foliage-is-cards.detail: (() => { const trees = [...objects('tree'), ...objects('bush')]; let cards = 0, solids = 0, modelled = 0; for (const t of trees) { if (t.userData && t.userData.asset) { modelled++; continue; } t.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (m && (m.alphaTest > 0 || m.transparent)) cards++; else if (/Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(o.geometry?.type ?? '')) solids++; }); } return 'trees+bushes: ' + trees.length + ', alpha-tested leaf cards: ' + cards + ', solid canopy primitives: ' + solids + ', modelled in Blender: ' + modelled + ' (need >= 6 cards per tree, 0 solids)'; })()
foliage-is-cards.note: Every object tagged tree or bush is built from alpha-tested leaf cards (≥ 6 meshes with alphaTest/transparent) and carries no sphere/icosahedron/capsule canopy. A solid crown reads as a boulder from every camera — foliage.js makeTree/makeBush is the recipe. A modelled asset (userData.asset from src/assets.js) counts as built from parts.

organic-not-solid.js: (() => { const organic = tags().filter(t => /tree|bush|canopy|crown|hedge|shrub|hay|straw|chicken|hen|dog|goat|sheep|cow|pig|horse|cat|bird|villager|npc|smoke/i.test(t)); let bad = 0; for (const tag of organic) for (const o of objects(tag)) o.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '') && m.material?.flatShading === true) bad++; }); return bad === 0; })()
organic-not-solid.detail: (() => { const organic = tags().filter(t => /tree|bush|canopy|crown|hedge|shrub|hay|straw|chicken|hen|dog|goat|sheep|cow|pig|horse|cat|bird|villager|npc|smoke/i.test(t)); const hits = []; for (const tag of organic) for (const o of objects(tag)) o.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '') && m.material?.flatShading === true) hits.push(tag + ':' + m.geometry.type); }); return 'flat-shaded sphere-like meshes under organic tags: ' + hits.length + (hits.length ? ' (' + hits.slice(0, 6).join(', ') + ')' : ''); })()
organic-not-solid.note: Nothing organic (trees, bushes, hay, animals, people, smoke) is a flat-shaded sphere/icosahedron/capsule. Faceted balls read as rocks; organic things are cards, parts, or smooth shapes with a material.

trees-read-as-trees.ask: Do the trees in this frame read as trees — a leafy, broken crown silhouette with gaps and a visible trunk or branches — rather than smooth or faceted balls, boulders or lumps sitting on posts?
trees-read-as-trees.note: Flora, from the primary camera: the crown must have a leaf silhouette and air in it. Pair with foliage-is-cards; the scene check proves the construction, this one proves the read.

logs-are-cylinders.js: (() => { const logs = [...objects('log'), ...objects('log-pile'), ...objects('firewood')]; if (!logs.length) return true; let bad = 0; for (const l of logs) l.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '')) bad++; }); return bad === 0; })()
logs-are-cylinders.detail: (() => { const logs = [...objects('log'), ...objects('log-pile'), ...objects('firewood')]; let bad = 0; for (const l of logs) l.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '')) bad++; }); return 'logs: ' + logs.length + ', sphere-built log meshes: ' + bad; })()
logs-are-cylinders.note: A log is a cylinder with cut ends, never a row of spheres (the village run shipped a "felled log" that was six ovoids). foliage.js makeLog/makeLogPile.
